data.name: NoRealData
data.value: All persons there are fictitious – please do not enter real data.

data.name: Login_Intro
data.value: You are now leaving the BürgerPortal for the sign-in page of a BundID simulator – a test system, not the real BundID.

data.name: Login_Step1
data.value: You choose a fictitious test person, an identification method (e.g. user name, ELSTER, online ID card) and a "business context" – the same context means the same person.

data.name: Login_Step2
data.value: The simulator sends the BürgerPortal a digitally signed confirmation (SAML) with the test person's data. The BürgerPortal verifies it and signs you in.

data.name: Login_Real
data.value: You would be redirected to the BundID (id.bund.de) and identify yourself with your own BundID account – with user name and password, ELSTER certificate or online ID card. The BundID would then transmit your real data to the BürgerPortal.
